span.p:
1. Unicode NFC
compose combining marks · strip bullets · collapse whitespace

span.p:
2. Tone-mark normalisation
hòa = hoà · thúy = thuý
NFC does NOT merge these two

NV → nhân viên · BHXH → bảo hiểm xã hội
TP/CP/CV handled by context

4. Mask salary figures
18 triệu → SALARY
keep '40 million users'

Leave as is
salary is a signal for the occupation
